contract: Save v4 tables (docs/design/save_v4_tables_2026-10-11.md, agreed by 게임성 개발 2 + 3 2026-10-11): additive defaults (the version is 4 since 게임성 개발 2's C1) - Craft { Smith / Alch / Tame { Lv 1..30, XP }, Rep, Made (64 ids) }, Research { Pts, Sum } (64 families), Gather { Day, N, Bloom, Gift, Total, FirstBloom }, Gear { Own '<kind>:T:P' -> 1..20 (letters-only kinds, tier 1..16, plus 0..10, written plainly and merged, 64 keys), On { Armor, Ring always, '' = empty }, Pet { uid -> worn slots, 64 pets } }, Buffs { tonic -> end, ended dropped, cut to now + 180, the 2 that end last }, Shop { Day, N 0..50 }, EggHonorAt (a future hour = 0). A repair never makes a value up and keeps a sane unknown flat key; repairing twice = once. DataService.fillDefaults runs Config.SanitizeSaveV4(d, os.time()); PetService.Sanitize keeps Roll { Spd = 5..10 } only.
limitations: No service writes these tables yet (GatherService, CraftService, GearService, the alchemy buffs, Otto's cheap materials and the golden egg come in their own branches). The version bump, Spares, Market and the 9-bit weapon mask are 게임성 개발 2's C1. The real DataStore load (the CR-L3 refusal of a newer record) is in tools/test_onboarding.py.
